title: FunkJunk's Tropical Goddesses
description: Three green-skinned women in profile face right, adorned with large banana earrings, leaves, and vibrant tropical flora. The foreground figure has white curly hair with a purple flower, while the background shows a classical building with a large arch under a purple-pink sky filled with musical notes, glowing circles, and a body of rippling water.
